summary: Frontend E2E testing of the redesigned /consultas page (CPF module) completed successfully. All requested behaviors validated: login, sidebar navigation, global Layout on /consultas (Sidebar visible), module tabs (cpf active; cnpj/telefone/nome disabled with 'Em breve'), CPF search happy-path with hero profile, score gauge/badge, category tabs, section cards + toggle expand, quota indicator, invalid CPF error, and history item reopens result. Security verified: only /api/consultas/* endpoints are called from the frontend; response payloads contain no 'agk_' API key, no 'signature', and no 'issuer' fields. Backend was previously validated by main agent (curl), spot-checked here via network responses (200 for /cpf and /historico, 400 for invalid CPF).
critical_code_review_comments: Consultas.js is ~518 lines and mixes label/icon maps, renderers, sub-components and main page — consider splitting into /pages/Consultas/{Consultas.jsx, HeroProfile.jsx, ScoreGauge.jsx, InfoCard.jsx, maps.js} for maintainability (>500 LOC rule).
carregarHistorico() swallows errors silently (empty catch). Consider surfacing a toast for network failures to aid debugging in production.
excluirConsulta() also has an empty catch — user gets no feedback when delete fails.

In renderValue/renderKeyValueGrid there is mutual recursion via function references; this is fine at runtime but the recursion depth is uncapped for deeply nested payloads — consider a max depth guard.
The 'index' prop passed to InfoCard is unused — dead prop.
Score derivation (getScoreInfo) parses the 'faixaScore' string with a regex; a malformed/localized string could yield NaN. Add a safe fallback.
